claim_boundary: This post-v10 outcome-informed v11 attacked pilot is fresh with respect to v11 attacked outcomes and paired to the completed v11 clean pilot. It can estimate exploratory task-utility and repeated joint-limit containment under the frozen prompt attacks. It cannot claim prevention of the first hit, overall physical safety, confirmatory efficacy, timing under co-tenancy, deployment, hardware, or perfect undetectability.
